## ⭐ The fix PR has been ejected again

So the fix for this flake has now been ejected by this flake at least twice. That is a self-sustaining shape: the repair cannot land through the queue while the defect it repairs is what ejects it.

⚠️ It also fits the stall measured at this round's open — `origin/main` has not moved in **~110 minutes** against an **11-minute median**. ⛔ Still not asserting causation; #14639 (every manifest-touching PR red) remains an equally live candidate and I cannot separate them from this seat. But "the fix keeps getting ejected" is a materially different situation from "no fix exists", and whoever owns #14648 should know it.

Recorded on #14648. Everything else — the diagnosis, the `p1`, the scope ruling (⛔ not a skip, ⛔ not a quarantine, ⛔ not a bigger round number) — lives there.
